tokenize_cpp_source: run the C++ tokenizer on a source file to get a sequence of named tokens with types
create_token: create a Token object with a token type, name, start index, and end index
parse_string_literal: parse a C++ string literal from source code handling escaped quotes and backslashes
parse_char_literal: parse a C++ character literal from source code handling escaped single quotes
review_tokenizer: review the GetTokens generator function to understand how it tokenizes C++ identifiers, constants, and preprocessor directives
